knowledge.title: What Fieldstone sells
knowledge.text: Fieldstone is crew scheduling and time tracking for landscaping, lawn care and snow removal companies with 20 to 300 field staff. Crews see the day's route on their phones, clock in at the job, and the office sees hours, drive time and equipment use per crew. Priced per crew per month.

knowledge.title: Customer profile, 2026
knowledge.text: Around 900 customers, mostly in the Midwest, the Mountain West and the Northeast. The typical customer runs 4 to 25 crews, owns its mowers and trucks, and adds snow removal in winter. The buyer is the owner or the operations manager. Most come to us in spring, when they add crews and the paper route sheets stop working.

knowledge.title: Proof we may use

site.description: Leases and loans for mowers, loaders, trucks and snow equipment, built for landscaping and snow removal contractors.
site.markdown:
# Equipment leasing for contractors who work outdoors

Aspen finances the mowers, loaders, trucks and snow equipment that landscaping, lawn care and snow removal contractors run every day. Decisions in two business days.

## Who we work with

Contractors with 10 to 300 employees across Colorado, Utah, Arizona and the Midwest. Most lease a fleet of five to fifty machines and replace a part of it every spring.

## For landscaping contractors

Seasonal payment plans that match your cash flow: lower payments in winter, higher in the growing season. Snow equipment financed before the first storm.

## Partners

We work with equipment dealers and with software vendors that serve contractors. Referral partners get a dedicated contact.

offer.name: Equipment hours that set the replacement plan
offer.summary: Contractors on Fieldstone get a leasing offer from Aspen built on the hours their machines ran last season, instead of a guess. You get a lessee who knows which five machines to replace. We get a referral partner that sees contractors the week they lease a new fleet.
you_bring: Seasonal leases and loans for mowers, loaders, trucks and snow equipment, decided in two business days
A dedicated contact for referral partners
Contractors replacing part of a fleet every spring
we_bring: Hours per machine from crew clock-ins, which a contractor can share with you when they ask for a lease
Routes and time tracking the crews already use, so the hours are there without extra work
Around 900 contractors, most of them in your states
offer.customer_gets: A replacement plan and a lease built on the hours each machine actually ran, from two companies that already know their crews and their fleet.

steps.title: Agree what a contractor shares
steps.detail: We settle on one export: machine, hours last season, crew. The contractor chooses to send it to Aspen. Nothing moves without them.

steps.title: Add Fieldstone to your landscaping page
steps.detail: Your new landscaping page lists us as a way to track machine hours. Our help center lists Aspen as a way to finance a replacement.

steps.title: Refer both ways through one contact
steps.detail: Your partner contact and I trade introductions every two weeks and keep one shared list of who was referred.

steps.title: Check the first season
steps.detail: After the spring season we look at how many contractors used the export and whether their lease decisions changed.

first_step.title: A 30 minute call on the machine hours export
first_step.detail: I show you the equipment hours a contractor sees in Fieldstone, and you tell me whether that is what your underwriters want to see for a replacement lease. If it is, we write the export together. If it is not, we know what to change.
first_step.ask: Pick a week, and bring whoever reads a contractor's equipment list when a lease comes in.
